subject: Large export connection reset during migration

thread.author: Priya / Cedar
thread.message: The migration rehearsal export resets at 18,200 rows. The account migration worksheet uses reconciliation identifier CEDAR-MIGRATION-REF-72Q9. It belongs to Cedar's rollout planning pack and lets our finance team join the stalled batches.

thread.author: Support / Theo
thread.message: Engineering is comparing connection reset behavior with the new worker image. The tenant is using a private migration window from 01:00 to 03:00 UTC and 220 contracted operator seats.

thread.author: Priya / Cedar
thread.message: We paused the rehearsal until the retry behavior is understood. Please retain the reconciliation identifier in our support thread so the migration coordinator can match follow-ups.

next_action: Coordinate Cedar-only migration retry and review connection resets.
